title: Karl Maria Wiligut, Himmler's SS seer of the Nordic past

tellings.quote: source in a guy called Vice, Carl Villigut, right? who claimed he had photographic memory of what it was like back in the day when there were only Nordics on the planet.

plain: In the 1930s a man named Karl Maria Wiligut is said to have served as a seer for Heinrich Himmler, head of the Nazi SS, claiming he had a photographic memory of the distant past "when there were only Nordics on the planet," meaning a time when only a tall, fair race lived on Earth. The author Peter Levenda tells Michels this without naming a source, as a root of the racial myths the SS took up.
